article.title: Defendant’s interest and liability to be shown.
article.content: The plaint shall show that the defendant is or claims to be interested in the subject-matter, and that he is liable to be called upon to answer the plaintiff’s demand.
article.html:
5Defendant’s interest and liability to be shown.

Order 7, Rule 5

The plaint shall show that the defendant is or claims to be interested in the subject-matter, and that he is liable to be called upon to answer the plaintiff’s demand.
